sourceNote: The A-pose elephant mesh (assets/models/elephant/README.md), with new quad faces on each arm from the shoulder line to the wrist. tools/blender/elephant_arms.py replays the Blender session that made it. The faces of the paws, the trunk, the legs, and the head are the faces of the source. elephant-apose.glb stays unchanged.
paintedNote: The weights of the clavicles and the arms are the automatic weights of Blender with the Weight Paint fixes of tools/blender/elephant_arms.py. The vertices on the bones of paintedLower keep the rule weights, because the trunk, the trunk of the head, and the ears depend on them.

armSegments.note: Each upper arm and each forearm has 4 deform segments, and each elbow and wrist a helper bone. The elbow helper is 0.052 units, twice the gap of the elbow rings (gap of tools/blender/elephant_arms.py), so that the inner elbow does not fold.

rootNormals.note: The skin faces whose middle lies within elbow (units) of the head of a forearm take the skin normals with no crease angle in the app (root_rim() of tools/blender/rig_mesh.py). This removes the light and dark creases at each bent elbow.

name: Elephant

app.note: The size of the elephant that the reference images give: the standing skull top (the highest vertex within 0.03 u of the middle plane, 1.0 u) at 1.920 m. Thus the standing shoulder joints are at 1.1616 m (ANIMALS). The reach goes from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.

armFactorNote: The arms keep the length of the mesh: 0.387 m from the shoulder joint to the middle of the palm.
legFactorNote: The legs keep the length of the mesh. The elephant stands at its timpani in the app, so no seat asks for longer legs.
jointsNote: The places are in the units and the axes of the studio in the source pose: 1 unit from the soles to the skull top, +z forward, +x the left side. The arms hang in an A-pose, about 45 degrees down. The tail hangs straight down behind the rump.

studio.note: legTurns gives the world turn of each left leg bone from the seated bind to the source (the values of the hippo). The elephant stands in the app (soloist of ANIMALS), so no player sits in this bind. Bind arms nearer to the A-pose fold more faces.

sliver.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

line.note: The angle 170 takes only the corners on the line. The long thin arm faces of this mesh run from the shoulder to the paw, and a lower angle mixes the trunk weight and the paw weight in their middle corners, so that faces fold.

haunch.note: The part of the thigh weight that goes to the hips grows from 0 at the lower height to 1 at the upper height, so that the round haunch stays on the hips. It starts below the crotch at y 0.19 and ends above it.

weights.note: Beyond the plane |x| = armSplit, only the free arm follows the arm bones. Above headFrom (the chin), each vertex follows the head only. The large ears follow the head, and earFlap gives the low ear flaps to the head. noseFront gives the trunk and the tusks to the head.

earFlap.note: The flap of each ear below y 0.76 and out of x 0.09 is apart from the head. The tip is the lowest vertex of the left flap. A higher cut joins the right flap to the shoulder.

flip.note: The values of the fox, the rabbit, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

check.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the panda.

tone.note: The mesh has warmer colors than SPECIES_COLORS.elephant. Each plain face takes the hue and the chroma of the species color of its band and keeps its lightness: a row is [L, dL, da, db] in Oklab. The cream tusks and nails (L above 0.85) and the toes keep their colors.

colors.note: The values of samples, palette, dark, and eyeShare are the values of the other meshes. A dark face in the eye box is a face of an eye. The config has no nose box, because the trunk has no nose pad.

eyeShell.note: The values of the fox, the cat, the dog, and the hippo.

chair.note: The chair of the rig sets the seat top of the seated bind under the haunch. The column legs lie under the body, so the seat ends behind them. The elephant stands in the app (soloist of ANIMALS), so no player sits on this seat.

crease.note: The values of the cat, the dog, the panda, and the hippo.

sit.note: The values of the panda and the hippo.
